## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

State the tested commit (and dirty-source fingerprint if applicable), actual PR target/base SHA, commands, and result. Use the safe per-run metadata in `output/checks/runs/`; do not attach raw logs, local diagnostics or account screenshots.

List failed, not-run, delegated and unavailable checks explicitly. Distinguish local checks, the PR event merge, and extracted-candidate checks. Record Windows/native/iOS limits; a workflow dispatch does not replace required PR validation.

- [ ] No credentials, personal paths or game assets included.
- [ ] Original contributions use the project license; third-party notices retained.
- [ ] Shared changes originate in the shared repository.
